purpose: Explain the different reference frames for prostate and pelvic-node IGRT without presenting synthetic displacement as measured motion.

source.repository: NCI Imaging Data Commons / The Cancer Imaging Archive
source.subject: Prostate-AEC-126

transformations.referenceContour: Clinically used manual prostate RTSTRUCT contour.
transformations.displacedContour: Synthetic translation of -8 rows and +10 columns solely for conceptual teaching; not patient motion and not a tolerance.
transformations.bonyEnvelope: CT values above 200 HU smoothed with a five-pixel Gaussian kernel and thresholded at 0.25 for a readable major-bone outline.
transformations.targetMatchIllustration: Inverse synthetic translation is applied to the derived bony outline to show the reference-frame trade-off; it is not a delivered couch correction.

limitations: No CBCT or measured setup error is displayed.
The displacement magnitude is illustrative and must not be interpreted as an action threshold.
A local protocol must define match order, tolerances and actions.
